audit_metadata.milestone: RC1.4.5.3.1 Final CORS Evidence & PR Metadata Cleanup

local_and_ci_verification.scope: Local Source Repository & CI Test Suite
local_and_ci_verification.details: FastAPI middleware strictly enforces zero 'unsafe-inline' scripts (script-src 'self' only), HTTP 307 direct-route redirects, exact CORS policy (including HEAD and X-CSRF-Token), and strict headers.

current_production_deployment.details: All 6 security headers are present and enforced on Railway edge. However, live CSP on Railway still contains legacy 'unsafe-inline' in script-src, and live CORS currently omits HEAD from methods and X-CSRF-Token from headers until post-merge deployment.
current_production_deployment.live_csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com data:; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob: data:; connect-src 'self' https://transify20-production.up.railway.app; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self';

pending_deployment_verification.details: Strict CSP without 'unsafe-inline' in script-src, along with HEAD method and X-CSRF-Token CORS support, is fully implemented and verified in branch commit but requires Railway deployment after PR #1 merge.

Strict-Transport-Security.description: Enforced on direct HTTPS or trusted proxy forwarded HTTPS. Omits includeSubDomains for single-domain deployment.

Content-Security-Policy.description: Strict script execution ('self' only, zero unsafe-inline in script-src). Style allows 'unsafe-inline' for dynamic theme variables.

X-Content-Type-Options.description: MIME-sniffing protection across all HTML, JSON, and static assets.

Referrer-Policy.description: Referrer leak protection sending origin only on cross-origin requests.

Permissions-Policy.description: Restricts browser device features to same-origin for assistive sign/voice.
